items.title: Frontend Developer Trainee
description: Contributed production features to three fintech applications — two React web dashboards and one React Native mobile app — inside an established, scalable frontend architecture.
Implemented responsive, reusable UI components shared across both web dashboards, prioritising render performance and long-term maintainability.
Integrated REST APIs and triaged live production issues through Sentry, diagnosing reported errors and improving release stability.
Reviewed pull requests and worked in Agile cycles, helping keep code quality consistent through iterative delivery.

items.title: Frontend Developer
description: Architected the frontend of a 13-module enterprise ERP — invoices, purchase orders, payments, manufacturers, customers, partners, accounts and financial reporting — where each feature slice owns its API layer, screens and state on one shared core.
Built a shared component and CRUD foundation of 58 components — data tables, form wrappers, validation, filtering, pagination — cutting a new module from 2–3 days to under one.
Integrated 63 typed REST endpoints through Axios and TanStack Query, with cached reads, optimistic updates and one consistent error-handling path.
Delivered role-based access control with permission-gated navigation, plus PDF/Excel export and barcode/QR scanning for warehouse workflows.
Implemented Arabic/English localization with full RTL across 19 translation namespaces — every screen mirrors without a second set of styles.
Engineered an image-based product configurator in layered SVG with clip-path masking: 7 garment parts across 5 views, with real-time colour, material, logo and text preview.
Shipped a 12-module restaurant admin dashboard covering orders, subscriptions, delivery, menu management, promotions and finance.
